query:
-- Add new columns to company_profiles
ALTER TABLE company_profiles 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS robots TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "showsAttending" TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "servicesNeeded" TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "logoUrl" TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "linkedinUrl" TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "onboardingComplete" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

-- Create service_requests table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_requests (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  "userId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "companyProfileId" INTEGER,
  "requestType" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  "showName" VARCHAR(255),
  "showDate" VARCHAR(100),
  "robotName" VARCHAR(255),
  "robotType" VARCHAR(100),
  details TEXT,
  urgency VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'normal',
  status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  "adminNotes" TEXT,
  "quotedPrice" VARCHAR(100),
  "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  "updatedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
